skills.name: SQLMap authenticated requests: Use an approved session cookie
skills.description: Test an authenticated endpoint without expanding account scope.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Obtain a temporary, least-privileged test identity and exact approved request headers.
2. Pass only required values through `cookie` or newline-separated `headers`; never place secrets in notes.
3. Set `cookie` to the temporary test session, scan only the approved URL/parameter, and redact the cookie from evidence.
4. Keep one endpoint in scope and rotate credentials after testing.

Safety: use only explicitly authorized accounts and targets with uthorized_target=true. Keep app defaults; do not dump records, open shells, read/write server files, evade controls, or perform destructive actions.
